story: Stage 4 saw an early breakaway including KOM leader Dries de Bondt, with a maximum gap of 3:30. A major crash at 42 km caused a race pause and 15 km reduction. After resuming, the break had 1:50 lead. On the final climb, the break was caught, with Bart Lemmen attacking 4.7 km out to claim victory, narrowly holding off Christian Scaroni.
